body.statement: For every \(\delta\in\mathcal D\) and \(h\in H\), the supremum of expected regret over \(U^{\ast}\in[\ell(h),u(h)]\) equals \(\max\{c_+(h)[1-q_{\delta}(h)],c_-(h)q_{\delta}(h)\}\). Consequently, Nature loses no value by restricting its pure strategies to \(S=H\times\{+,-\}\).
body.justification: The reduction identifies the exact adversarial state space and prevents a hidden restriction to hand-picked endpoint pairs.
body.gap: MontielOleaQiuStoye2026Local writes the interval game directly; the present lemma isolates the signed endpoint game needed for unrestricted duality.
body.consumer: Every saddle certificate and every numerical separation oracle operates on the reduced endpoint-state space.
